title: Hi everyone, I’m Minto — indie dev & plugin creator from Japan

posts.author: MintoTsukino
posts.body:
Hey there!
I'm Minto from Japan — just someone who loves making little things in RPG Maker MZ.
I’ve been experimenting with plugins, shaders, and other small tools recently.
I really enjoy seeing what other creators make here, and I hope to learn a lot too.
Nice to meet you all!

posts.author: fizzly
posts.body: Hello Minto, nice to meet you. I hope you will feel good here! Happy game making!
